premise.claim: ThinEngine.parseFuseOptions starts with `ro` when the dataset is ReadOnlyMany (the default when accessModes is empty), then does `options = profile.Spec.Fuse.Options` when the ThinRuntimeProfile has any fuse options. That replaces the map, so `ro` is lost and the fuse container's MOUNT_OPTIONS has no `ro`: a read-only dataset is mounted read-write. The assignment also makes `options` the profile's own map, so the runtime options that are copied in afterwards are written into the profile object.
premise.evidence: On base 896d21e: TestVerifyRoKeptWhenProfileDefinesOptions FAIL (MOUNT_OPTIONS="profile-opt1=p1,profile-opt2=p2,runtime-opt=r1", no ro) and TestVerifyProfileOptionsMapNotMutated FAIL (profile map gained runtime-opt); the PR's own two new ginkgo specs grafted onto base also FAIL. See results/base-unit-harness.txt and results/base-pr-ginkgo-grafted.txt.
